title.zh: Kimi进军游戏工业，让AI Agent接管从开发到运营的整条工作流
title.en: Kimi进军游戏工业，让AI Agent接管从开发到运营的整条工作流

current_state.zh: Moonshot's Kimi launched a game-development and creative-workflow solution in which AI agents operate Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender and Godot to design gameplay, build 3D assets, modify existing projects, run and test builds, and support publishing, live-ops and AI-driven NPC dialogue.
